name: SAMAIDEN
recent: Samaiden 与 Parkland 签署谅解备忘录，计划在马来西亚半岛投资高达 RM4bil 的清洁能源项目。公司公布 2026 财年第一季度业绩，净利按年增长 106.9% 至 RM12.7 million，主要受 LSS5 项目利润率提升带动。此外，公司于 11 月 26 日召开第七届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。
notable: 与 Parkland 签署谅解备忘录，探讨在马来西亚半岛开发可再生能源项目，潜在投资额高达 RM4bil。
2026 财年第一季度净利按年增长 106.9% 至 RM12.7 million。
第七届常年股东大会所有决议获股东通过。
risks: 独立非执行主席 Dato' Dr Nadzri bin Yahaya 于 9 月多次减持公司股份。
首席策略官 Dr Tee Wu Shun 于 9 月多次减持公司股份。
earnings: 2026 财年第一季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM105.7 million，按年下降 21.6%，按季增长 55.8%；净利为 RM14.76 million，按年增长 107.7%，按季增长 61.8%；净利率为 14.0%，高于上一季度的 13.4%。

recent_en: Samaiden signed an MOU with Parkland to explore up to RM4 billion in clean energy investments across Peninsular Malaysia. The company reported Q1 FY2026 net profit up 106.9% YoY to RM12.7 million, driven by higher margins from LSS5 projects. Its 7th AGM was held on 26 November 2026, with all resolutions passed.
notable_en: Signed an MOU with Parkland to explore renewable energy projects in Peninsular Malaysia with potential investment of up to RM4 billion.
Q1 FY2026 net profit rose 106.9% YoY to RM12.7 million.
All resolutions were passed at the 7th AGM.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Dr Nadzri bin Yahaya disposed of shares multiple times in September.
Chief Strategy Officer Dr Tee Wu Shun disposed of shares multiple times in September.
earnings_en: For Q1 FY2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was RM105.7 million, down 21.6% YoY but up 55.8% QoQ; net income was RM14.76 million, up 107.7% YoY and 61.8% QoQ; net margin was 14.0%, up from 13.4% in the previous quarter.
